notablePrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Avenger of Zendikar that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Avenger of Zendikar token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least two 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
If you control three or more lands, this combo nets infinite colorless mana and creature tokens.
